title.zh: LCRO：爱情类型测试完整解读

headline.en: initiate proposals / receive care / practical starting point / flexible arrangement
headline.zh: 发起提议／接受照顾／实际起点／弹性安排

summary.en: You may enjoy getting an ordinary plan moving, being looked after within it, and keeping the next step practical but adjustable. Initiating and receiving care are different jobs: suggesting the afternoon does not require you to provide every form of support.
summary.zh: 你可能喜欢先推动一个日常安排，在相处中接受照顾，并让下一步既实际又有弹性。发起安排和接受照顾是不同角色：先提议下午做什么，不意味着整段互动都要由你承担。

title.en: What the four choices describe
title.zh: 四组选择分别描述什么

paragraphs.en: L describes preferring to put forward an opening proposal, then checking the other person’s response. It concerns who offers a starting direction in these ordinary scenarios, not authority, dominance, gender, or the right to decide for someone else. C concerns wanting to receive comfort or small acts of care in the moments described. Wanting care can coexist with offering it. The comparison does not measure neediness, attachment security, dependence, or whether you contribute enough to a relationship.
paragraphs.zh: L描述更愿先提出起始方案，再听对方回应。它只涉及这些普通情境里谁先提供方向，不涉及权力、支配、性别，也不赋予替别人决定的权利。C关注题目时刻里希望得到安慰或小照顾。想被照顾可以和提供照顾并存；这组比较不衡量黏人、依恋安全、依赖或对关系贡献是否足够。

paragraphs.en: R gives practical circumstances the first look in low-stakes relationship choices: time, energy, distance, or what a plan requires. It does not measure intelligence or show that you feel less. Practical judgment and romantic feeling can both be present. O favors leaving room for an arrangement to develop or change, while keeping communication honest. It does not mean permission to break agreements, hide intentions, or disregard consent. Flexibility still benefits from knowing what has and has not been agreed.
paragraphs.zh: R是在低风险关系选择中先看时间、精力、距离或计划要求等现实条件。它不衡量智力，也不证明感受较少；实际考虑和浪漫感可以同时存在。O偏向让安排保留发展或变化空间，同时诚实沟通。它不许可违约、隐瞒意图或忽视同意；有弹性仍可分清哪些已约定、哪些尚未约定。

title.en: One ordinary situation, not a prediction
title.zh: 一个普通情境，不是行为预测

paragraphs.en: Imagine suggesting a nearby café because the journey fits both schedules. You then say that you would enjoy your partner choosing a comfortable seat and checking in with you. You leave the activity after coffee undecided rather than treating the invitation as an all-day promise.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，你先提附近咖啡馆，因为双方时间和路程都合适；接着说明，想让对方挑个舒服座位、关心一下自己的状态。咖啡之后做什么先不定，这次邀请并不自动成为一整天的承诺。

paragraphs.en: If your partner instead offers a distant surprise, you might welcome the attention while asking about travel time. That question need not cancel the affection. A useful distinction is whether you are asking for a workable version or silently expecting the other person to guess all your needs.
paragraphs.zh: 如果对方提议较远的惊喜，你可以一边欢迎这份心意，一边问清路程。问实际条件未必是否定感情；值得分清的是，你在寻找可行版本，还是期待对方不经说明便猜中所有需要。

title.en: Where the combination may need clarification
title.zh: 组合里哪些地方值得说清

paragraphs.en: A possible friction is that you make the opening proposal clearly but leave the care you want implicit. A partner may hear an organizer who needs no help, then feel confused when the outing seems disappointing despite following your plan. The code cannot tell whether this happens to you.
paragraphs.zh: 一种可能的摩擦是：你清楚提出活动，却没有说出希望怎样被照顾。对方可能把你理解成无需帮助的组织者，照计划做了仍发现你失望。这个组合代码不能证明你现实中确实如此。

paragraphs.en: Flexibility also needs a boundary. If the café plan is confirmed but the rest is open, say exactly that. Otherwise one person may keep an entire afternoon free while the other assumes they are free to make another arrangement. Both readings can be understandable without either being a character flaw.
paragraphs.zh: 弹性也需要边界。若咖啡时间已确认、之后仍开放，可以把两者说开。否则一人可能留出整个下午，另一人却以为之后可另作安排；这种误差不必解释成某一方性格有问题。

title.en: Compare the four one-letter neighbors
title.zh: 比较四个只差一字母的组合

paragraphs.en: FCRO keeps the other three choices but changes this comparison from initiate proposals to respond to proposals. LARO keeps the other three choices but changes this comparison from receive care to offer care. Compare the actual situations rather than deciding which code is better.
paragraphs.zh: FCRO保留另外三组选择，只把这一组从“发起提议”改为“回应提议”。LARO保留另外三组选择，只把这一组从“接受照顾”改为“提供照顾”。可以比较具体情境，不必评定哪个代码更好。

paragraphs.en: LCPO keeps the other three choices but changes this comparison from practical starting point to romantic starting point. LCRE keeps the other three choices but changes this comparison from flexible arrangement to explicit intention. Compare the actual situations rather than deciding which code is better.
paragraphs.zh: LCPO保留另外三组选择，只把这一组从“实际起点”改为“浪漫起点”。LCRE保留另外三组选择，只把这一组从“弹性安排”改为“明确意图”。可以比较具体情境，不必评定哪个代码更好。

title.en: An optional private next step
title.zh: 可选的私人下一步

paragraphs.en: Privately write one sentence with three parts: the plan you would suggest, one small form of care you would like, and the point at which the plan ends. For example, separate “coffee at three” from “please ask how my week went” and “I have not promised dinner.”
paragraphs.zh: 可以私下写一句含三部分的话：你想提的计划、希望得到的一种小照顾，以及约定在哪里结束。例如把“三点喝咖啡”“希望你问问我这周过得怎样”和“尚未约晚饭”分别写清。

paragraphs.en: Then check whether all three parts still suit your chosen situation. You can revise the note without contacting anyone. If the wish to receive care changes when you are less tired, record that context rather than trying to preserve LCRO as a stable personal identity.

title.en: What the four choices describe
title.zh: 四组选择分别描述什么

paragraphs.en: L describes preferring to put forward an opening proposal, then checking the other person’s response. It concerns who offers a starting direction in these ordinary scenarios, not authority, dominance, gender, or the right to decide for someone else. C concerns wanting to receive comfort or small acts of care in the moments described. Wanting care can coexist with offering it. The comparison does not measure neediness, attachment security, dependence, or whether you contribute enough to a relationship.
paragraphs.zh: L描述更愿先提出起始方案，再听对方回应。它只涉及这些普通情境里谁先提供方向，不涉及权力、支配、性别，也不赋予替别人决定的权利。C关注题目时刻里希望得到安慰或小照顾。想被照顾可以和提供照顾并存；这组比较不衡量黏人、依恋安全、依赖或对关系贡献是否足够。

paragraphs.en: P gives the first look to the felt attraction or romantic meaning of an ordinary possibility. It does not mean ignoring safety, resources, or another person’s wishes. A preference for emotional appeal is not a measure of impulsivity or how deeply you love. E favors explicit intention and a clear shared expectation. It is not a moral rating, a test of fidelity, or proof of greater commitment. An agreement can be small and revisable, and the other person remains free to want something different.
paragraphs.zh: P是在普通可能性里先留意吸引力或浪漫意义。不意味着忽略安全、资源或对方愿望；偏向情感吸引不衡量冲动，也不衡量爱得多深。E偏向明确意图和清楚共同期待。它不是道德评分、忠诚测试或承诺更深的证明；约定可以很小、可以修改，对方仍可想要不同安排。

paragraphs.en: In a fictional scene, you suggest celebrating a small anniversary with a personal letter. You would enjoy being reassured that your effort is welcome, and you ask what kind of celebration feels meaningful to both people rather than assuming the date carries an identical promise for each.

title.en: Where the combination may need clarification

paragraphs.en: One tension is linking reassurance, emotional intensity, and explicit intention so tightly that a pause feels like a verdict. Someone may need time to find words even when they care. Separate what you are asking to do now from what you are asking the relationship to mean.
paragraphs.zh: 一种张力是把安慰、情绪浓度和明确意图绑得太紧，使片刻停顿像一场裁决。即使在意，对方也可能需要时间组织语言。可以把当下想做的事和希望关系意味着什么分开。

paragraphs.en: Another is turning a meaningful occasion into an undeclared test. A clear intention is more understandable when you state it before the event, while allowing different preferences and a real refusal. Neither enthusiasm nor hesitation should be assigned a moral value from these four letters.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种风险是把重要日子变成未声明的考验。若提前表达意图，并允许不同偏好和真实拒绝，双方更容易理解；热情或犹豫都不应凭四个字母被赋予道德高低。

paragraphs.en: Check whether the proposed clarification is small enough for the actual stage of the relationship. If the answer is no, reduce the request rather than using LCPE as a reason to accelerate it. The useful outcome may simply be a clearer private understanding of your current wish.

scoreReading.zh: 各字母在自己的八次比较中次数较多，或属于4:4并列的一侧时，LARE就是兼容组合。请同时看四轴原始次数；兼容代码不是概率或诊断。

title.en: What the four choices describe
title.zh: 四组选择分别描述什么

paragraphs.en: L describes preferring to put forward an opening proposal, then checking the other person’s response. It concerns who offers a starting direction in these ordinary scenarios, not authority, dominance, gender, or the right to decide for someone else. A concerns enjoying being someone who offers comfort and welcomes a partner’s reliance. This is a relative preference between paired moments, not evidence that you should always provide support, never need help, or assume responsibility for another person’s feelings.
paragraphs.zh: L描述更愿先提出起始方案，再听对方回应。它只涉及这些普通情境里谁先提供方向，不涉及权力、支配、性别，也不赋予替别人决定的权利。A关注喜欢提供安慰、欢迎对方依靠的角色。这只是成对时刻里的相对偏好，不证明你应始终支持别人、永不需要帮助或负责对方感受。

paragraphs.en: R gives practical circumstances the first look in low-stakes relationship choices: time, energy, distance, or what a plan requires. It does not measure intelligence or show that you feel less. Practical judgment and romantic feeling can both be present. E favors explicit intention and a clear shared expectation. It is not a moral rating, a test of fidelity, or proof of greater commitment. An agreement can be small and revisable, and the other person remains free to want something different.
paragraphs.zh: R是在低风险关系选择中先看时间、精力、距离或计划要求等现实条件。它不衡量智力，也不证明感受较少；实际考虑和浪漫感可以同时存在。E偏向明确意图和清楚共同期待。它不是道德评分、忠诚测试或承诺更深的证明；约定可以很小、可以修改，对方仍可想要不同安排。

title.en: One ordinary situation, not a prediction
title.zh: 一个普通情境，不是行为预测

paragraphs.en: Imagine proposing a recurring grocery trip during a busy period. You ask whether help is wanted, choose a time that suits both people, and agree on what each person will do. The agreement may make ordinary life easier without needing to represent a larger relationship commitment.
paragraphs.zh: 设想忙碌期间，你提议定期一起采购，先问是否需要帮忙，选双方方便时间，再说清各做什么。这个约定可以只为生活省力，无需代表更大的关系承诺。

paragraphs.en: If the other person needs a different kind of support, the useful response may be to revise the arrangement rather than perfect the original plan. “Would reminders help or feel intrusive?” is a question about a concrete action. The code cannot answer it on your partner’s behalf.
paragraphs.zh: 若对方需要另一种支持，有用的回应可能是修改安排，而非把原方案做得更精细。“提醒对你是帮助还是打扰？”是在问具体行为，代码不能代替对方作答。

title.en: Where the combination may need clarification
title.zh: 组合里哪些地方值得说清

paragraphs.en: A possible friction is that clarity turns into supervision. Agreeing on a shared task does not make you responsible for checking every detail of the other person’s behavior. The distinction is especially useful when a helpful routine starts to feel like a rule one person is enforcing.
paragraphs.zh: 可能的摩擦是，明确逐渐变成监督。约定共同任务，不意味着你负责核查对方每个行为细节。一个有帮助的惯例若开始像由一人执行的规则，就值得重新分清两者。

paragraphs.en: You may also overlook your own wish to receive care because the organizer role is easy to describe. Choosing A in more prompts does not erase that wish. A practical agreement can include rest, a limit on your contribution, and a point at which either person can reconsider.
paragraphs.zh: 你也可能因为组织者角色容易描述而忽略自己想被照顾的时刻。A选得较多不会抹去这种愿望；实际约定也可以包含休息、贡献上限及双方重新考虑的时间点。

paragraphs.en: FARE keeps the other three choices but changes this comparison from initiate proposals to respond to proposals. LCRE keeps the other three choices but changes this comparison from offer care to receive care. Compare the actual situations rather than deciding which code is better.

title.en: An optional private next step
title.zh: 可选的私人下一步

paragraphs.en: Privately write one shared task as an invitation rather than an instruction. State the offer, ask whether it suits the other person, and name how either person could change it. Keep the proposed agreement small enough that a refusal is genuinely possible.
paragraphs.zh: 可以私下把一个共同任务写成邀请而非指令：说明提议，询问是否适合对方，并写出双方如何修改。让约定足够小，拒绝才会是一个真实选项。

paragraphs.en: Then list one piece of care you would like in return without presenting it as payment owed. This separates your needs from the assistance you offer. No one needs to see the list; the exercise can end when your own boundaries are clearer.
paragraphs.zh: 再写一种你自己希望得到的关心，不把它列成对方欠下的报酬。这样能分开自己的需要与提供的帮助；清单无需给任何人看，边界更清楚后就可以结束。

title.en: Recompute the result and keep ties visible
title.zh: 复算结果，保留并列

paragraphs.en: There are 32 original pairs, eight on each axis. Count one selection for the chosen letter and zero for its alternative; each pair contributes only to its own axis. The two counts on an axis always sum to eight. A 5:3 result means five choices versus three in this bank, not 62.5% of a personality or a population rank.
paragraphs.zh: 共有32道原创二选一，每轴八题。所选字母记一次，另一侧不记；每题只进入本轴，两侧次数合为八。5:3表示本题本五次与三次选择，不是62.5%的人格，也不是人群排名。

paragraphs.en: A 4:4 comparison retains both letters. Combine the retained letters across the four axes to obtain every compatible code: one tied axis gives two, two give four, three give eight, and all four give sixteen. No random draw, hidden priority, or tie-break question selects a winner. If LARE appears alongside another guide, read both without treating their order as a ranking. Partial or invalid answers produce no interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 4:4保留两个字母。把四轴保留字母交叉组合，即得到全部兼容代码：一轴并列两种、两轴四种、三轴八种、四轴十六种。不靠抽签、隐藏优先级或加题挑赢家。若本指南和其他指南一起出现，可以都读；顺序不代表排名。未完整或无效作答不产生解释。

title.zh: 版本、局限与隐私

Public L/F, C/A, R/P and O/E framework terms inform the topic only. It does not reproduce the official LoveType question bank, scoring, characters, artwork or type descriptions. Sixteen possible codes come from four binary comparisons; they are not sixteen scientifically established kinds of person.

title.en: What the four choices describe
title.zh: 四组选择分别描述什么

paragraphs.en: F describes preferring to begin with a partner’s proposal and then respond with your own view. It is not obedience or an absence of initiative: a response can include a counterproposal, a clear boundary, or a refusal. A concerns enjoying being someone who offers comfort and welcomes a partner’s reliance. This is a relative preference between paired moments, not evidence that you should always provide support, never need help, or assume responsibility for another person’s feelings.
paragraphs.zh: F描述更喜欢先有对方提议，再表达自己看法。它不是服从或没有主动性；回应可以包含另一个方案、清楚边界或拒绝。A关注喜欢提供安慰、欢迎对方依靠的角色。这只是成对时刻里的相对偏好，不证明你应始终支持别人、永不需要帮助或负责对方感受。

paragraphs.en: P gives the first look to the felt attraction or romantic meaning of an ordinary possibility. It does not mean ignoring safety, resources, or another person’s wishes. A preference for emotional appeal is not a measure of impulsivity or how deeply you love. O favors leaving room for an arrangement to develop or change, while keeping communication honest. It does not mean permission to break agreements, hide intentions, or disregard consent. Flexibility still benefits from knowing what has and has not been agreed.
paragraphs.zh: P是在普通可能性里先留意吸引力或浪漫意义。不意味着忽略安全、资源或对方愿望；偏向情感吸引不衡量冲动，也不衡量爱得多深。O偏向让安排保留发展或变化空间，同时诚实沟通。它不许可违约、隐瞒意图或忽视同意；有弹性仍可分清哪些已约定、哪些尚未约定。

title.en: One ordinary situation, not a prediction
title.zh: 一个普通情境，不是行为预测

paragraphs.en: Imagine your partner suggesting an impromptu picnic. You like the emotional appeal and offer one thoughtful addition, such as bringing a familiar snack. You are happy to decide the exact spot together, provided both people can change the plan if the weather, energy, or interest shifts.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，对方临时提议野餐，你被气氛吸引，愿意加一份体贴，如带熟悉小食。地点可以一起到时决定，但天气、精力或兴趣变化时，双方都可修改安排。

paragraphs.en: If your partner seems less enthusiastic later, you could ask what changed rather than working harder to restore the original mood. Care might mean a shorter outing, a quieter plan, or no outing. The useful action depends on what is welcome now, not on preserving a romantic story about the day.
paragraphs.zh: 若后来对方热情下降，可以问变化原因，不必加倍努力恢复原气氛。照顾也许是缩短、改安静计划，甚至不出游。行动取决于此刻欢迎什么，不是维护当天的浪漫故事。

title.en: Where the combination may need clarification

paragraphs.en: A possible tension is responding so warmly that your own reservations become hard to see. You may enjoy the idea and still dislike one detail. Stating a preference does not cancel affection; it helps the other person understand what part of the experience you actually want to share.
paragraphs.zh: 一种张力是，回应太温暖而使自己的保留难以看见。你可以喜欢点子，同时不喜欢其中一个细节。表达偏好不会取消关心，而能帮助对方知道你真正愿意共享哪一部分。

paragraphs.en: Another is assuming that the open nature of the plan means there is no need to confirm anything. Even spontaneous experiences involve small agreements about meeting, leaving, spending, or privacy. Clarifying one such detail can protect the freedom of both people without making the experience feel like a fixed script.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种情况是，以为开放计划就完全不用确认。即兴体验也有见面、离开、花费或隐私的小约定。说清其中一项，可以保护双方自由，不必让体验变成固定剧本。

paragraphs.en: Then ask whether your contribution still feels optional. If it feels like the price of being included, note that concern rather than using the result to explain it away. You may keep the reflection private and make no change to any real relationship.

Partial or invalid answers produce no interpretation.

This original bank has no established reliability, validity, norms, or English–Chinese measurement equivalence. Counts describe choices within this edition and situation, not the strength of love, maturity, attachment, fidelity, safety or another person’s inner state.
paragraphs.zh: 四组二侧比较在数学上产生十六种代码，不证明存在十六种天然人格。本原创题本尚无已确立的信度、效度、常模或中英文测量等值。次数只描述本版本和所选情境里的选择，不衡量爱意、成熟、依恋、忠诚、安全或他人内心。

paragraphs.en: Use a result as a private prompt for describing a preference. It cannot decide whom to date, whether to stay, or how a relationship will develop. A small optional conversation example is included in each guide, but no contact, disclosure, purchase or matching result from a partner is required.
paragraphs.zh: 结果可作为私下描述偏好的提示，不能决定与谁交往、是否继续或关系怎样发展。每篇有可选小讨论例子，但不要求联系、披露、购买或让伴侣获得某个配对结果。

title.en: Private attempt and public guides
title.zh: 私人作答与公开指南

paragraphs.en: Answers and counts remain in this browser’s current attempt. Saving progress is optional and uses a session draft valid for 24 hours; you can clear it or continue without saving. Public guide URLs identify a general code only. Sharing copies the public title and entry link, excluding your answers, counts and compatible-code set.
paragraphs.zh: 答案与次数留在当前浏览器作答中。可选保存使用24小时内有效的会话草稿，也可以清除或不保存。公开指南网址只标识通用代码。分享仅复制公开标题与入口链接，不包含答案、次数和个人兼容代码集合。

paragraphs.en: The complete result is free, without an email wall. You can compare all sixteen guides, return to the test list, or finish here. The references below explain the framework context; they do not validate our original questions or authorize conclusions about a real partner.
paragraphs.zh: 完整结果免费，无邮箱门槛。可以比较十六篇指南、返回测试列表或就此结束。下列参考说明框架背景，不验证本原创题目，也不授权对真实伴侣作结论。

question.en: Is this the official Japanese LoveType test?

answer.en: No. This is an independent FermatMind edition with 32 original pairs, an open counting rule and 16 neutral combination guides. It uses public four-axis terms as context, without copying the official bank, algorithm, characters, artwork or result prose.
answer.zh: 不是。这是费马独立版本，使用32道原创二选一、公开计次规则和16篇中性组合指南。公开四轴术语仅供背景，不复制官方题库、算法、角色、美术或结果正文。

answer.en: Each axis has eight choices. A 4:4 tie retains both letters. Cross-combining retained letters gives all compatible codes, from one to sixteen; all complete readings are shown. No random winner, hidden priority or additional tie-break is used.
answer.zh: 每轴八次选择；4:4保留两个字母。跨轴组合后得到一至十六个兼容代码，全部完整读法都会展示。不随机选赢家，不设隐藏优先级，也不额外破并列。

question.en: Can it predict compatibility or relationship success?
question.zh: 能预测伴侣适配或关系成功吗？

answer.en: No. The counts describe choices in this original bank and chosen situation. Reliability, validity, norms and language equivalence are not established. There are no matching pairs, success probabilities, diagnoses of a partner, or predictions about staying together.
answer.zh: 不能。次数只描述本原创题本与所选情境里的选择；尚无已确立的信度、效度、常模或语言等值。不提供匹配配对、成功概率、伴侣诊断或关系去留预测。

question.en: Is the full result free, and what is shared?
question.zh: 完整结果免费吗，分享包含什么？

answer.en: All 16 complete guides and every compatible result are free, without signup, email or purchase. Sharing copies only the public test title and entry link. Your answers, counts and compatible-code set are excluded. Saving a browser session draft is optional.
answer.zh: 16篇完整指南和所有兼容结果均免费，无需注册、邮箱或购买。分享仅复制公开测试标题与入口链接，不包含答案、次数和个人兼容代码集合。浏览器会话草稿可选保存。
